hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street throughout the visible block.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk pavement is heavily cracked with uneven surfaces and vegetation growth, creating significant trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and midground walkway

hazards.name: Utility Pole Obstruction
hazards.description: A wooden utility pole is situated directly in the middle of the sidewalk, narrowing the effective width for pedestrians and wheelchair users.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground

hazards.name: Roadway Deterioration
hazards.description: The edge of the roadway is crumbling and contains loose debris near the curb line.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom edge of the image along the curb

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Large vehicles, such as the black pickup truck in the foreground, significantly block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground and along both curbs

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the curb with no planting strip or parked cars to separate pedestrians from moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire length of the visible sidewalk.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: A continuous line of parked vehicles on both sides of the narrow street creates significant blind spots for both drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the visible street length

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked places for pedestrians to cross this residential street safely within the visible area.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of sidewalk buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the curb with no buffer zone, placing pedestrians in close proximity to parked and moving vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: The edge of the sidewalk adjacent to the parked cars

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street creates significant visual barriers between drivers and pedestrians, particularly children, who may attempt to cross between cars.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the visible street segment.

hazards.name: Narrow Sidewalks
hazards.description: The sidewalks on both sides of the street are very narrow, which may force pedestrians to walk in the roadway if they are with others or using mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street adjacent to the houses.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossing
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible, which may lead to unpredictable pedestrian movements across the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the visible roadway.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street limits sightlines between drivers and pedestrians, particularly children, who might step into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the visible street.

hazards.name: Lack of designated crossing points
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs visible, requiring pedestrians to cross the street without a protected or prioritized space.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of street lighting
hazards.description: No street light poles are visible in the immediate vicinity, which may reduce pedestrian visibility and safety at night.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire streetscape

hazards.name: Uneven Sidewalk
hazards.description: Concrete sidewalk slabs on the left side are misaligned and cracked, creating a significant tripping hazard for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground and midground walkway

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The right side of the street lacks a continuous paved sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to walk on unpaved surfaces or in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the narrow street may obscure pedestrians, especially children, from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway

hazards.name: Uneven sidewalk surface
hazards.description: Cracks and overgrown grass on the sidewalk create trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground sidewalk

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Calming
hazards.description: The long, straight, and unmarked roadway may encourage vehicle speeds that are unsafe for a residential street with high pedestrian potential.
hazards.location_in_image: The central asphalt roadway

hazards.name: Sidewalk Surface Degradation
hazards.description: Cracks and vegetation growth in the sidewalk joints create uneven surfaces that could be a tripping hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Visible in the foreground and middle ground of the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian signage are visible, forcing pedestrians to cross in unmarked areas with poor visibility.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the visible roadway

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossings
hazards.description: The intersection lacks any painted crosswalks, reducing driver awareness of pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection ahead

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: No sloped transitions exist at the intersection, creating a barrier for wheelchair users and strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corners of the intersection

hazards.name: Narrow/Obstructed Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the left is narrow and encroached upon by grass and vegetation.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image

hazards.name: Narrow and constrained walkway
hazards.description: The effective width of the sidewalk is limited by adjacent fences and the proximity of parked cars, which may force pedestrians into the roadway if obstructed.
hazards.location_in_image: Sidewalks on both the left and right sides of the street

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at potential crossing points to move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight and shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to physically enforce low speeds on this residential block.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility continental-style crosswalk markings at the nearest intersections to define safe crossing paths.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or other vertical deflection measures to ensure low vehicle speeds in this shared environment.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Replace the degraded concrete with a smooth, level, and continuous walking surface to ensure ADA compliance.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole to a dedicated furniture zone or behind the sidewalk to clear the pedestrian through-zone.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Install a planting strip between the curb and the sidewalk to provide a physical buffer from traffic and improve the streetscape.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Green Infrastructure
interventions.description: Incorporate street trees or planters to create a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, improving the pedestrian experience and safety.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees to create a natural buffer between the sidewalk and the street, enhancing safety and comfort.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Add a planting strip with street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical buffer and improve the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at intersections or mid-block to increase pedestrian visibility, shorten crossing distances, and prevent parking too close to crossing points.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation and improve the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalks to meet modern accessibility standards and improve pedestrian comfort.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential environment.

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and security after dark.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Leveling
interventions.description: Replace or level the displaced concrete slabs on the left side to ensure a smooth, ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a complete and safe pedestrian network.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and level the sidewalk to provide a clear, hazard-free path for all users.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or street trees between the curb and the sidewalk to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and security for pedestrians during evening hours.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Repair
interventions.description: Repair cracks and remove vegetation to ensure a smooth, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings at the nearest intersections to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Incorporate street trees or a planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all intersection corners to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Maintenance
interventions.description: Clear encroaching vegetation and widen the sidewalk to a minimum of 5-6 feet to meet modern standards.
